description: This file defines the SugarWidgetReportField class, which extends SugarWidgetField. It provides methods for rendering report fields, generating SQL snippets, handling sorting and filtering, and managing field aliases within the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM reporting framework. The class interacts with layout definitions, database conversions, and currency objects for dynamic report generation.

classes.name: SugarWidgetReportField
classes.description: A widget class for rendering and managing report fields within SugarCRM/SuiteCRM, including SQL generation, sorting, filtering, and alias management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the widget with a layout manager and retrieves the reporter attribute.

methods.name: getSubClass
methods.description: Returns a subclass widget based on the layout definition's type, supporting specialized rendering.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Delegates display rendering to a specific subclass or method based on context.

methods.name: _get_column_select_special
methods.description: Generates SQL snippets for weighted sum or amount calculations.

methods.name: _get_column_select
methods.description: Constructs the SQL column selection string considering aliasing, group functions, currency conversion, and database specifics.

methods.name: querySelect
methods.description: Returns SQL SELECT clause string for the given layout definition.

methods.name: queryGroupBy
methods.description: Returns SQL GROUP BY clause string for the given layout definition.

methods.name: queryOrderBy
methods.description: Generates SQL ORDER BY clause considering sorting direction and text type conversions.

methods.name: queryFilter
methods.description: Delegates filter query creation based on qualifier name.

methods.name: displayHeaderCell
methods.description: Generates HTML for column header, including sorting links and icons.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Delegates to subclass methods for SQL query parts based on context.

methods.name: _get_column_alias
methods.description: Creates a unique alias for a column, considering group functions, table, and column names.

methods.name: queryFilterEmpty
methods.description: Generates SQL filter clause for empty or NULL values.

methods.name: queryFilterIs
methods.description: Generates SQL filter clause for equality on a given value.

methods.name: queryFilteris_not

methods.name: queryFilterNot_Empty
